attestations.note: The life page `/3311/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian, and it is the same man: the fellow worker of Cyril and Methodius in Bulgaria whom the Greek calls Θεοφόρος and θαυματουργός. **No `dates` key is drafted.** The folder holds 830 to 23 December 910 from doxologia.ro; saint.gr says only «τον 9ο αιώνα (842 μ.Χ.)», which is a date set against the mission of Cyril and Methodius and not against Naum's own years, so there is nothing here to put against what the folder holds. The page adds his journey to Rome to the then Pope Adrian and his preaching in Germany, and ends with «Ο θάνατος τον βρήκε όρθιο» — death found him on his feet. It names no place of relics and no coordinate is proposed. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (28 September 2026).

hymns.text:
Ucenic vrednic al Sfinţilor Chiril şi Metodie, te-ai arătat fericite,
Şi tămăduiri din destul ai revărsat cu dragoste sufletelor smerite,
Ca cel ce te-ai arătat luminător mare celor din întunericul neştiinţei,
Cu raza rugăciunii tale ne înconjoară şi pe noi în ceasul umilinţei.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Naum; the page prints the four rhymed lines and no tone

english.text: A worthy disciple of Saints Cyril and Methodius you were shown to be, O blessed one, and healings in plenty you poured out with love upon humble souls; and as one who was shown a great light to those in the darkness of ignorance, surround us also with the ray of your prayer in the hour of our lowliness.
